0022600002.text: Both the Philadelphia 76ers and the New York Knicks open their 2026-27 seasons when the 76ers visit New York. The teams split their 2025-26 regular-season series 2-2, and the 76ers lost their 2025-26 playoff series 0-4, including a 144-114 loss in Philadelphia on May 10, 2026. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (out, ruptured Achilles) and Dominick Barlow (out, back), and Adem Bona (foot sprain), Anfernee Simons (hamstring), Dean Wade (ankle sprain) and Tacko Fall (hip) are listed as day-to-day, with Bona, Simons and Wade game-time decisions. New York has Josh Hart listed day-to-day with ankle soreness, also a game-time decision, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the 76ers a 45% chance to win.
